subject.title: Gateway should expose HTTP REST endpoints for common queries

question: Should OpenClaw expose read-only session list/detail data through the existing default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin, through new dedicated REST GET endpoints, or keep this data on WebSocket/CLI surfaces for now?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing session data over HTTP changes a security-sensitive operator API boundary and creates a public integration contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Extend admin HTTP RPC allowlist
options.body: Add read-only session query methods to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit docs, auth/scope tests, and no duplicated session-store logic.

options.title: Add dedicated REST endpoints
options.body: Create thin authenticated GET routes for session and agent queries if maintainers want REST semantics instead of JSON-RPC for web integrations.

options.title: Defer HTTP session exposure
options.body: Keep session list/detail access on WebSocket and CLI until maintainers are ready to own a broader HTTP control-plane contract.

recommendation.title: Extend admin HTTP RPC allowlist
recommendation.body: Add read-only session query methods to the default-off admin HTTP RPC plugin with explicit docs, auth/scope tests, and no duplicated session-store logic.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete owns the current admin HTTP RPC/security-doc boundary that would be expanded or rejected here.
